result.title: Greedy Orthogonal Polynomial Manifolds with Lipschitz Control for Dimensionality Reduction and Reduced Modeling
result.summary: Polynomial manifolds provide nonlinear low-dimensional representations through polynomial decoders. We propose to represent the polynomial terms of the decoder using features that are orthonormal on the training data. This empirical orthogonality enables a greedy algorithm, Greedy-OPM, which jointly selects encoder modes and polynomial features while minimizing the reconstruction error under a prescribed bound on the decoder's Lipschitz constant. Numerical experiments show that this Lipschitz constraint improves generalization away from the training data while retaining high reconstruction accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Greedy-OPM：用训练数据上正交归一的多项式特征构建多项式 decoder，并在给定 Lipschitz 常数上界下贪心联合选择 encoder 模式与多项式特征以最小化重构误差；数值实验显示该约束在保持重构精度的同时改善远离训练数据的泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其正交化特征与 Lipschitz 约束控制低维表示到输出映射的平滑性，可能为核查 latent 状态表示的几何约束与分布外泛化评价提供方法线索，但需判断是否适用于 VLM 隐状态。
